notes.title: The Mammoth now in 25 languages!
notes.content:
Woah! That's a lot of languages! Thanks to all of our wonderful community translators for submitting their work!

Many of the new languages aren't supported by Steam, but you can choose your language in-game, from this huge list:


Arabic
Basque
Belarusian
Bulgarian
Catalan
Chinese
Czech
Danish
Dutch
French
German
Hebrew
Italian
Japanese
Korean
Mongolian
Polish
Portuguese
Russian
Serbian
Spanish
Thai
Turkish
Ukrainian

notes.title: A Mammoth language update
notes.content:
The Mammoth now has subtitles for the following additional languages:

Italian
Russian
Thai
Danish
Bulgarian
Simplified Chinese
Japanese
Basque
Turkish
Catalan
Czech

Thanks to everybody who helped contribute translations! We at inbetweengames are very grateful. If you'd like to help, check out this forum thread
